test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The operation is to be distinguished from other forms of heart surgery and, in particular, from the repair of openings between the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **"auricles."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The operation being referred to is distinguished from other forms of heart surgery and repair of openings between the auricles.
 
• **"Auricles" **are the two upper chambers of the heart that receive blood from the veins and contract to force blood into the ventricles. (हृदय का उपरि-गह्वर जिसमें से रक्त प्रवाहित होकर सारे शरीर में जाता है; आलिंद)
 
 
• **Example**: *There is a large **auricle**__ or flap on one side of the umbo.*
 
 
 
• The repair of openings between the auricles is a different type of heart surgery.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: The operation is to be distinguished from other forms of heart surgery and, in particular, from the repair of openings between the __**auricles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (oracles)** is not a correct answer and does not make sense in the context of heart surgery. "Oracles" can refer to a person or thing regarded as a source of wise counsel or prophetic opinions. (प्राचीन ग्रीस में एक स्‍थान जहाँ लोग भविष्‍य के विषय में देववाणी सुनने जाते थे; लोगों की मान्‍यता के अनुसार देववाणी सुनाने वाले पुरोहित)
 
• **Option 3 (oculus) **means a round or eye-like opening or design, such as a circular window or an opening at the apex of a dome. (एक गोल या आँख जैसा खुला भाग या डिज़ाइन, जैसे गोलाकार खिड़की या गुंबद के शीर्ष पर एक खुला भाग)
